description: Source code for internal HTTP request handling in the golang.org/x/net/internal/httpcommon package, including request header encoding, validation, and request construction.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request with URL, method, headers, trailers, and content length.

classes.name: EncodeHeadersParam
classes.description: Parameters for encoding request headers, including request data, gzip option, header size limit, and default user agent.

classes.name: EncodeHeadersResult
classes.description: Result of encoding headers, indicating presence of body and trailers.

classes.name: ServerRequestParam
classes.description: Parameters for constructing a server-side HTTP request, including method, scheme, authority, path, protocol, and headers.

classes.name: ServerRequestResult
classes.description: Result of constructing a server request, including URL, request URI, trailers, and error reason.

methods.name: EncodeHeaders
methods.description: Constructs and validates HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 request headers from a Request object, calling a provided header function for each header.

methods.name: IsRequestGzip
methods.description: Determines whether to add an Accept-Encoding: gzip header based on request method, headers, and compression settings.

methods.name: checkConnHeaders
methods.description: Checks for invalid connection-level headers in an HTTP request.

methods.name: commaSeparatedTrailers
methods.description: Generates a comma-separated string of trailer header keys, validating against forbidden keys.

methods.name: validPseudoPath
methods.description: Validates the :path pseudo-header value for HTTP/2 requests.

methods.name: validateHeaders
methods.description: Validates header field names and values for correctness.

methods.name: shouldSendReqContentLength
methods.description: Decides if a Content-Length header should be sent based on method and content length.

methods.name: NewServerRequest
methods.description: Constructs a server-side HTTP request from parameters, handling trailers, authority, and request URI.
